ModMetadata.Name: Stationeers Toolkit [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Shane Yu
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers Toolkit[/h1] [i]An experimental live IC10 and LUA editing via VS Code extension.[/i]
Enabled remote editing of IC10 chips and LUA chips, when StationeersLua is installed, via an external IDE using our Stationeers Toolkit VS Code extension. Stationeers Toolkit adds a friendly live network and chip editor for IC10, with Lua chip editing available when StationeersLua is also installed. Without StationeersLua, the mod still works for IC10 chips.
To allow the VS Code extension visibility and access to the IC and LUA chips within the game, you must place and connect a Remote Network device on your networks you want to expose.
Any networks without a Remote Network device will not be visible to the VS Code extension.
For LUA chips the extension hours the StationeersLua settings whereby you can only edit active LUA chips on a connected network, this is usually via opening a editor in the game or connecting wirelessly via the Wireless Development Board. The LUA chips are discovered by the Remote Network devices regardless and shown, with a indication of whether they are "accessible". IC10 chips are always accessible regardless and can be edited without any additional requirements.
[i]You can use this alongside the StationeersLua extension, though editing the same code in both extensions at once is not recommended. Stationeers Toolkit is a great choice if you also want IC10 language support, testing, scenarios, and the other features in the extension.[/i]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [/list]
[h2]VS Code Extension[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=shaneyu.stationeers]VS Code Marketplace[/url] [*] [url=https://open-vsx.org/extension/shaneyu/stationeers]Open-VSX[/url] [/list]
